text:
Alex Cheng: quick ping — PR #2711 (kv-evict-improve) is ready from my side but CI is failing only on macOS integ shard. I need 1 approver to merge. Any chance someone can take a fast look? link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/pr/2711 :wave:

CI Bot: Build failed on macos-integ-3 (pytest exit code 5). Failing test: tests/integration/test_kv.py::test_eviction

CI Bot: snippet from log:
```
E       AssertionError: Expected 3 keys after eviction, got 2
redwood.infra.kv_test:142: AssertionError
--- command ---
/opt/ci/run_integ --shard macos-integ-3 --test tests/integration/test_kv.py::test_eviction
```

Priya Shah: can you paste the full failing stack? I can try a targeted rerun on the macOS runner. :eyes:

Alex Cheng: full stack is above, that's the main assertion. Locally i can't repro on linux, but i can repro on a macOS VM with a tight timing window. Repro command i used: `PYTEST_ADDOPTS='-k test_eviction -q' python -m pytest tests/integration/test_kv.py`

Jonah K: i noticed a snapshot update in the same PR touched eviction timing comments — i'm wary of updating snapshots to silence flakes. Might be a race in the eviction timer now that we reduced the lease from 200ms -> 100ms.

Alex Cheng: agree — the code change intentionally reduced the lease. The test was asserting exact counts and didn't allow for eventual consistency. I can change the test to use our `wait_for` helper and assert >= 2 then eventually 3, but that is a small behavioral adjustment.

Priya Shah: i'd prefer a test change rather than skipping or new snapshot. If you push that as a follow-up commit i can review quickly. Meanwhile i can trigger a targeted rerun to see if it's consistently failing. @Tara (oncall) any objections to merging after a quick test fix + green CI?

Tara (oncall): no objections. If Priya approves we can merge after macOS passes. i'll kick off a targeted rerun now and hold the merge slot for PR #2711. :white_check_mark:

CI Bot: Targeted rerun started: macos-integ-3 (rerun by Tara). Link: https://ci.redwood-inference/reports/3751234567/rerun

Alex Cheng: thanks all. i'll open a tiny test patch in the same branch (add wait_for + looser assert) and push. ping me if you want me to revert snapshot changes — i can split them out.

Priya Shah: i'll review once the test patch lands. tagging for follow-up: @Jonah K for any sanity check on eviction semantics.

Jonah K: will look after lunch. if test-change is just stable assertion i'm fine with approving. :+1:

Alex Cheng: pushed test update (commit 9b3f2a4). CI will re-run on push. thanks for the quick responses — appreciate it :pray:

CI Bot: macos-integ-3 re-run completed: PASSED. All shards green.

Tara (oncall): looks green, Priya can you LGTM and i'll queue merge?

Priya Shah: LGTM, leaving a small comment about clarifying the wait timeout but not blocking. :thumbsup:

Alex Cheng: awesome, thanks everyone. merging now.

Jonah K: nice — great follow-through.

Alex Cheng: (post-merge) merged and cherry-picked into release branch. thanks again!
